cell_budget: Common budget min(128, minimum retained-well cell count), excluding only extraction failures below 32
preprocessing: Center and isotropic scale from development-plate reference controls only, equal cells per well
reference: 128 cells pooled equally from eight plate/side reference wells
mmd: Biased Gaussian MMD squared, median development-reference distance bandwidth
sliced_w2: 64 fixed random directions, squared W2 with 128 equal mass cells
local_abundance: Maximum absolute occupancy difference in 16 development-reference prototype balls, median 10th-percentile neighbor radius
empirical_flags: Score exceeds own plate/side calibration empirical 95th percentile; descriptive only, no formal error control
uncertainty: 2000 well-resampling bootstrap draws of treated-minus-heldout score mean, stratified by side; conditional on fixed references and preprocessing
mixture_pairing: Each donor paired with deterministic same plate/side heldout background; 128 total cells; rounded treated-cell counts; no independent biological replicate claim
spatial: Primary side-local references; alternative adjacent-column reference subsets and nearest-row reference subsets; all remain confounded in column
claims: Treatment-associated morphology; no causal inference, biological independence, calibrated significance or novelty
weighted_mixture_supplement: Exact treated empirical mass on equal donor/background support budgets, to avoid rounding 1% to zero; added after cell-count QC, before effect scoring. Native 0/100 endpoints must agree.
post_primary_sensitivity: Direct same-row adjacent DMSO comparisons added after primary baseline scores; exploratory, no fitting or threshold changes.
